task: Identify the latest updated image to video model available on Huggingface and summarize its main features.
answer: The latest updated image-to-video model on Hugging Face is WAS/Pika-H3-Flex-PTD (updated about 5 hours ago at the time of verification, task tag Image-to-Video, License: pika-community). It was identified by applying the dedicated Image-to-Video task filter on the Models page and sorting by 'Recently updated' via the sort dropdown. Main features from its model card: Pika-H3-Flex-PTD is a distilled, few-step variant of the MiniMax H3 video generation model adapted for the Pika H3 architecture, packaged for ComfyUI. It supports fl2va (first-frame-to-video) and Ref2VA (reference-picture-to-video) workflows, enabling text-to-video with sound, and runs efficiently in few inference steps. The model card includes usage instructions for ComfyUI workflows and notes it is a pruned/distilled checkpoint for faster image-to-video generation.
